stories.title: Operator configures Postgres-backed runtime state
stories.i_want: setup and start to use .ks/config.json and a reachable Postgres database
stories.so_that: runtime state is consistent across API, worker, and CLI processes

stories.title: Developer imports and exports config as code
stories.i_want: JSON import/export for one project, all projects, or full deployment
stories.so_that: state can be reviewed, versioned, debugged, and moved between environments

stories.title: Worker processes durable Postgres-backed jobs
stories.i_want: the worker to use a maintained Postgres queue
stories.so_that: retry, dead-letter, and observability behavior are not custom SQLite logic

stories.title: Auditor trusts append-only DB audit records
stories.i_want: audit rows protected by database roles
stories.so_that: normal app credentials cannot mutate history
